Anytime you need a creative spark, more inspiration, or a breakthrough, you simply turn the knob of the Galactic Gumball Machine sitting on your desk.

Out rolls a "random" gumball, except it is not random at all. Each one is encoded with a color and a symbol that act as a message and an activation prompt to:

  • Unlock cosmic "coincidences"
  • And it all tastes wonderfully delicious at the same time

A One-of-a-Kind Art Piece

Each Galactic Gumball Machine is a one of a kind art piece, personally designed and doodled by Yanik Silver, including the actual gumballs. Yours is personalized with your specific symbols, power animals, and soul magic for infinite creativity. The gumballs are blessed to be the highest cosmic catalysts of creativity for you.

Your actual Galactic Gumball machine, hand doodled just for you and signed.

So I can eat the Galactic Gumballs? Yep.

They are made with natural colors, natural flavors, and natural chicle from the Central American chicozapote tree, the original chewing gum. The flavors are Orange, Berry, Tangerine, Lemon-Lime, and Classic Bubble Gum. The symbols are all hand drawn on the gumballs with edible ink.
